sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/344 (ReserveOhio API ohiordr.usedirect.com: search/place PlaceId 344, search/grid facilities 406 'Loops A, B, C', 407 'Loops D, E', 405 'Loop F', 408 Equestrian for 2027-06-15 and 2027-01-12, search/details for all 315 web-listed units on 2027-06-15, plus one site of each type on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12 and 2027-06-19, read 2026-10-30)

values.note: Electric sites $39 a night, full hookups $52, the same on a Saturday (June 2027). Off-peak (November 2026, January 2027) both are $35. The 27 primitive horsemen's sites (horse campers, off Furnas-Oglesbay Road) are $23. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-30.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all Caesar Creek units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Electric 39.00, Campsite Full Hookup 52.00, Campsite Equestrian Non-Electric 23.00, Fee 6.50); sites 001 and 036 on Sat 2027-06-19 (39.00 / 52.00), 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12 (35.00 / 35.00), read 2026-10-30

hookups.source: ReserveOhio search/details (Electricity Hookup '50' or '50/30/20' on 280 of 281 campsites; Water Hookup and Sewer Hookup 'Yes' on the 35 full-hookup sites) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/caesar-creek-state-park-campground ('287 campsites with 50-amp electric service, including 35 full hook-up sites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: 281 web-bookable RV campsites in loops A-F (246 electric, 35 full hookup), all back-in, rated for camping units to 40 ft (two full-hookup sites 37 ft). ODNR counts 287 campsites (252 electric). Mostly shady and partly shady; pets permitted on all sites. A separate horsemen's camp has 27-29 primitive sites.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid (96 + 101 + 84 units in the three loop facilities, all AllowWebBooking) + search/details (PullInTypeName 'Back In', Maximum Camping Unit Length 40 on 204 electric and 30 FH sites, 37 on 2) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/caesar-creek-state-park-campground ('252 Electric sites', '35 Full Hookup sites', 'mostly shady and partially shady sites', 'Caesar Creek Equestrian Camp offers 29 primitive campsites'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: Check-In Store (camping supplies, firewood, ice, kayak rentals); camper's beach, a small swim area and a boat ramp to the 2,830-acre unlimited-horsepower lake; dump stations by loops D and E.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/caesar-creek-state-park-campground ('Showers, flush toilets, dump stations'; 'Camper's beach, boat ramp, playground'; 'A convenient Check-In Store ... offers camping supplies, firewood, ice, ice cream, novelties, and kayak rentals'; 'waste dump stations near loops D & E'), read 2026-10-30

values.note: In winter only loops A-C are sold (January 2027); loops D-F are blocked.

season.source: ReserveOhio search/grid for 2027-01-12 (facility 406 Loops A-C: 93 of 96 free; 407 Loops D-E and 405 Loop F: all blocked) + search/details rates for 2026-11-17 and 2027-01-12, read 2026-10-30

values.note: Reservations up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. All sites are reservable; a walk-up buys an open site at the camp store, or on reserveohio.com when the store is closed. Maximum 14 days in any 30; check-in 3 p.m., check-out 1 p.m.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/caesar-creek-state-park-campground ('Reservations are required and may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727.'; 'Walk-in? All sites are now reservable. If the camp store is open, please check in with staff and they will be able to sell you any sites that are available. If the camp store is closed, please visit reserveohio.com'; 'Maximum stay is 14 days within a 30 day period.'; 'Check-in time is 3:00 p.m. check-out time is at 1:00 p.m.') + ReserveOhio search/details (MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-30

summary: Fees confirmed ($39 electric base, +$13 full hookup) and added the $35 off-peak rate. Added 50-amp electric with water/sewer at 35 FH sites, 281 back-in RV sites rated to 40 ft, showers/flush toilets/dump/check-in store, year-round season (loops A-C in winter), ReserveOhio deep link, 6-month window, walk-ups sold through the system, 14-in-30 max, check-in/out times. Pin 456 m from the sites' centroid. Not stated for this park: the weekend minimum (left inherited).
flags: Phone missing: the ODNR campground page gives (937) 488-4595 (the campground's Check-In/Camp Store); the park office is (513) 897-3055.
Pin 456 m off: it sits at the campground entrance road east of the loops, 130 m from the nearest site. Centroid of ReserveOhio's 281 loop A-F site coordinates: 39.53503,-83.98032.
